migration.status_ko: V1 파생 JSON 수치와 출처를 분리 보존했다. 아래 V1 검증/추출 주장은 과거 기록이며 이번 원자료 재검증 결과가 아니다.
migration.canonical_json_definition: UTF-8 json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"), allow_nan=False), no trailing newline
retention_notes: All four IDs, labels, derived floating-point values and both complete 101-point arrays are retained without resampling or smoothing.
series_cells and parallel_cells were copied from V1 catalog metadata into each runtime JSON; no new pack measurement was made.
Original source objects and provenance are retained below; flags such as whole_file_md5_verified describe V1 claims only.
Original curve_csv names and artifact hashes refer to V1 artifacts, not V2 files. V2 uses embedded arrays and does not require those CSVs.
Raw VAH01 data and the historical verification logs are no longer local according to the V1 explanation; raw extraction was not rerun.
Local source-file hashes identify the inspected migration inputs, not scientific validation or runtime acceptance.
